name: 💡 Feature Request
description: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Thanks for your feature request! Please fill out the template below.
        
        ## Motivation
        Please describe the motivation or use case for this feature.
        
        ## Proposed Solution
        A clear description of what you want to happen.
        
        ## Alternatives Considered
        Any alternative solutions you've considered.
        
        ## Additional Context
        Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
        
        ## Your AI Companion Style (Optional)
        We want to understand your use case better:
        - What would you name your AI companion?
        - What relationship stage are you aiming for?
        - What features matter most to you?
